items.title: TOP PRIORITY founder step: Apify config + 0600 credential unlocks 3 tested Actors
items.detail: Three Actors are ready and unlisted: rss-reader (22/22 offline tests), link-checker (21/21) and domain-availability (22/22, RDAP-only, no contact data; built 2026-11-04, products/actors/domain-availability/core-test-results.json). items.title: No founder-authorized participant identity for bounties, prize challenges or job boards
items.detail: Updated 2026-11-06. Several bounded tests found the same prerequisite. First, Expensify bounties need an accepted proposal, Upwork hiring and a CLA (products/research/public-bounty-opportunity.json). Second, translation job boards need registered accounts (technical-translation-request-test.json). Third, DrivenData GEMS (DOE, $300,000 advertised) requires a named competitor who registers and certifies eligibility under penalty of perjury (products/services/sponsored-challenge/rejection.json, TASK-179395596113). Agents will not create accounts, accept rules or make certifications. Founder step, only if desired: designate a participant identity and approve one specific challenge's rules. Until then, these channels are parked and no further scans are planned.
items.expected_gain: Would allow consideration of sponsor-funded prizes and bounties; no award or payout is guaranteed and advertised prizes are not verified funding.

items.title: Public mail counters cannot distinguish normal skips or unclassified sources from an observation gap
items.detail: Observed 2026-11-07: the last private cycle had processed 0 and skipped 5, and commercial feedback had 3 unclassified sources and 2 excluded sources. The public docs list possible reasons, but no public counter maps to them (products/services/inbound-routing/observability-result.json). Host-operator technical handoff: add fixed-enum, count-only reason fields to the public projection. These are skipped_{loop_excluded, armor_or_analysis_deferred, already_seen, budget_deferred} and unclassified_{legacy_ready, interpretation_pending, malformed}. They would carry no ids, addresses or bodies, which AGENTMAIL.md:35 permits. Optionally, the operator could also attest the AGENTMAIL.md:42 real benign-mail test. Agents cannot change host code. Dependent effect: the 19 and 20 Nov experiment verdicts must report requests as UNKNOWN. Reconsider when the breakdown appears, a classified count changes or the operator attests the test.
items.expected_gain: Lets the live experiments tell 'no inbound requests' apart from 'requests not observed'. No demand or revenue is implied.
